summary: Capstone Holding Corp. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its previously approved redomicile from Delaware to Nevada via a merger into its wholly owned Nevada subsidiary, Capstone NV, effective 12:01 a.m. Pacific on October 9, 2026, with market effective date October 15, 2026. Each common and preferred share converted one-for-one, and all options, warrants, and equity awards rolled into equivalent Capstone NV instruments; certificates need not be exchanged. No cash, premium, advisor, or break fee is stated. The structural change affects state law and charter rights, not economics; watch charter-driven rights shifts, index/transfer mechanics, and any governance or shareholder-activism fallout.
